# The cost cap of a swarm is agents.max_tree_budget_usd. Each call costs 1.00 and the cap is 1 dollar.
# The first two tasks start together: the rendezvous holds each one until the other runs, so both pass the look at the cap with a sum of 0. They run and land.
# The next tasks find a sum of 2, so the engine holds their agent step. No third agent starts, and the status shows the stop at the cap of the tree.
isolate
swarmfakes

env BEEHEST_AGENTS_MAX_TREE_BUDGET_USD=1
exec beehestswarm item add swarm swarm-1 --title 'The swarm' --body-file backlog.txt
! exec beehestswarm run swarm-1 swarm --workflow swarm/workflow.star &
waitstatus 'stopped at the tree cap'
kill -KILL
wait

# Two tasks ran and landed, and the held tasks started no agent.
grep -count=2 '^task ' calls.log
grep -count=2 '^MergePR ' forge/calls.log

-- rendezvous --
-- cost --
1.00
-- backlog.txt --
P0	one	a.txt
P1	two	b.txt
P2	three	c.txt
P3	four	d.txt
